observation_ref.description: Optional successful document.inspect/v1 or per-entry document.list/v1 Evidence from this Run; fixes acquisition to the observed document and storage version. Invalid or missing evidence fails without ordinary-read fallback.

publish_artifact.description: Persist exact converted UTF-8 Markdown as an immutable Run Artifact for approved document.write. File mode also creates a local readable copy; no external document write.

response_mode.description: Use file with publish_artifact=true and workspace.read permission to receive only a readable file path and metadata; full bytes are saved as an Artifact. Inline preserves the legacy response.
